triadic_descent.CIF: The exact E program opens the three internal species roles n,p,d and reversible n+p<->d reaction hypergraph on the inherited three-channel parent possibility state.
triadic_descent.QV: The C/D constitutive gap g_C supplies the association/action rate while the exact complete-support edge rate a=g_C/3 supplies the reverse/reopening rate; all symmetry-equivalent parent-role assignments are retained rather than arbitrarily labeled.
triadic_descent.RFL: The deuteron-like composite abundance, conserved ledgers, reaction-flow freeze witness, branch covariance and restartable H_E_to_F are stabilized as E memory.

species_and_graph.semantics: RFC internal Module-E species roles only; no empirical nuclear identity or calibrated Standard Model correspondence is claimed at MINIMAL_SPINE.

parent_to_E_interface.reason: C and D preserve an exactly symmetric unlabeled three-channel carrier. E may not assign empirical identities to those channels. Preserve every ordered n/p assignment and treat the remaining channel as an RFL memory reservoir returned symmetrically to the primitive pair before E association begins.
parent_to_E_interface.central_rule: arithmetic quotient over all six equally lawful role assignments; no branch is selected as empirically preferred
parent_to_E_interface.no_loss_check: Each branch has initial baryon ledger 1 and zero initial d; the full D carrier sum is retained because the unused channel is split one-half/one-half into n and p.

rate_law.derivation: Association uses the full nonuniform QV relaxation gap; reverse/reopening uses one exact complete-support relational edge. Both are inherited from C/D and introduce no new coefficient.

intrinsic_energy_ledger.claim_boundary: dimensionless parent-gap-scaled energy only; no MeV binding energy or calibrated nuclear Q-value

clock_and_interval.clock: tau_E dimensionless intrinsic reaction clock beginning at the D->E interface
clock_and_interval.max_step_rule: t_end/128 inherited from immediate-parent D baseline resolution convention
clock_and_interval.freezeout_witness: first accepted state satisfying |J_E| <= |J_E(0)|/e, where J_E=kf*n*p-kr*d
clock_and_interval.freezeout_meaning: one e-fold QV compression of net reaction flow, recorded into RFL memory; no SI time or public freeze-out temperature

network_size_and_route_rule: The source-owned physical graph has the two exact reversible channels. Network-size convergence is tested by splitting each exact channel into 1,2,4 algebraically equivalent witnessed relational routes whose summed propensity is unchanged; withheld-forward/reverse runs are separate ablations and must materially differ. No unsupported extra species/reaction is invented.

uncertainty.required: For each inherited D delta-envelope member, rederive g_C, a, branch family, interval and all six E branch outputs without retuning; report branch covariance and combined branch-plus-decimal-envelope covariance.

countermodels: SCALAR_COLLAPSE: erase six branch identities into one unlabeled scalar before conservation/charge bookkeeping; must be rejected because branch charges differ
CHARGE_BREAK: perturb stoichiometry so exact charge/baryon nullspace fails
FORWARD_WITHHELD: kf=0 must materially alter E state
REVERSE_WITHHELD: kr=0 must materially alter E state
gates: withheld reaction and independent implementation checks
falsifiers: any public/remembered abundance target enters generation
finest dyadic step pair differs above 1e-8 L_inf
1/2/4 exact route splitting differs above 1e-8 L_inf
independent reduced reaction-extent implementation differs above 1e-8 L_inf
withheld forward or reverse channel fails to materially change result
scalar branch collapse is treated as equivalent to branch-resolved state
independent_verifier_design: Reconstruct g_C and a from the C constitution and D ancestry, independently generate all six parent-role assignments and the [0.5,0.5,0] symmetry quotient, integrate the reduced one-dimensional reaction extent with an independent DOP853 implementation, and compare branchwise against primary BDF outputs without trusting gate summaries.
claim_boundary: Internally generated RFC minimal-spine primordial three-species branch-family state with parent-derived reversible rates, exact baryon/charge/internal-energy accounting, reaction-flow freeze witnesses and inherited representation uncertainty. No calibrated physical nuclear rates, MeV binding energies, SI times, Standard Model isotope correspondence, observational abundance agreement, or old Li7 mechanism is claimed.
